description.value:
Frequency once per day

Requirement You are wielding two loaded firearms.

Make six ranged Strikes divided as you like between the two weapons and any number of targets, each at a −2 penalty, all counting toward your multiple attack penalty as a single attack. You may Hot Load any number of them, spending a use for each, and you roll Gun Failure (§3) only once at the end for all of them combined.

cinderfall.incomplete: (the single-combined-Gun-Failure-roll clause has no RollTable-batching hook either). This card's entire effect is a limited-use activated action/reaction that hands the actor a wholly new usable action -- per this pass's fixed bucket-3 convention this is always INCOMPLETE regardless of precedent. Ironsight's own real-world analog, the Gunslinger, ships this exact shape unencoded across dozens of its own Strike-variant/reload-trick/called-shot feats (e.g. pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/gunslinger/level-10/called-shot.json, level-6/scatter-blast.json, level-1/dual-weapon-reload.json, all rules: []) -- confirming this is the standard shape for a gunfighter class, not license to SKIP. This effect is defined entirely in terms of a Cinderfall-homebrew subsystem with zero Foundry schema footprint (the Gun Failure Table/Failure Range, hazardous ground, time-in-sights, Trick Iron charge bank, or Drift/augment-slot cost). Confirmed via the full rule-element type listing (pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/, 40 files): no RollTable-manipulation, no persistent-terrain-hazard, and no arbitrary stacking-counter rule element type exists to hook any of these to.
